assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
Given the recent transient cerebral ischemic attack, continuous mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with arrhythmic activity and optimize rate control management.
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered.
The diagnosis codes I48.91 and I49.5 support the underlying arrhythmia conditions.
The transient cerebral ischemic attack underscores the need for continuous monitoring.
